title: Exporting packs, patches, and mods
key_points: Godot enables developers to add functionality to their game after it has been deployed through resource packs (PCK files or ZIP files).
Advantages of using PCK/ZIP files include incremental updates, offering downloadable content (DLC), supporting mods, and preventing source code disclosure.
Resource packs can contain scripts, scenes, shaders, models, textures, sound effects, music, and other assets suitable for import into the game.
limitations: Loading PCK files for patches, mods or extra content requires coding a system to automatically load files based on their location and possibly name, which is a security vulnerability.
Godot provides no out-of-the-box way to prevent someone from copying the PCK file and putting it on another person's computer if used to distribute paid content like expansions.
asserts: Resource packs (PCK files or ZIP files) enable developers to add functionality, patches, mods or extra content to their deployed game without needing to replace the entire game.
